title: Mamdani Stands By His Handling of Oct. 7 Anniversary After Emotional Day
summary: The mayor expressed no regrets after he was criticized by Jewish leaders over a statement marking the anniversary of the Oct. 7 attacks and later booed by pro-Palestinian activists at a vigil.
